contexts.text: To lend = to instruct from the affection of charity. Illustrated.
To lend () = to do good from the affection of charity, thus to communicate the goods of Heaven, and also the goods of the world; but the latter for the sake of the former as the end.
To lend () = from the affection of charity to communicate the goods of Heaven; thus to instruct.
To lend () = the communication of truth.
He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him () = that he shall teach thee truths, but thou shalt not teach him.
To lend () = to communicate the goods and truths of doctrine from the Word.
